query.semantics: All original operations mandatory; original calendars/grid; hard terminal deadlines

reduction.scope: All feasible declared discrete schedules preserved. No infeasible-state energy preservation is claimed.

metadata.objective: Unit feasibility penalties only; zero iff query feasible
metadata.proof: Sum of integer squares and binary conflict products is nonnegative. It is zero iff exactly one legal assignment is selected per operation, with no original constraint conflict and all hard query limits satisfied.
metadata.qualification: Preserves query-feasible schedules, not the original soft-objective landscape. A nonzero heuristic return does not prove infeasibility.
